national.thresholdNote: Major party contesting both electorates and the party vote; historically well above the 5% party-vote threshold.

labour.thresholdNote: Major party contesting both electorates and the party vote; historically well above the 5% party-vote threshold.

green.thresholdNote: Contests electorates and a long party list; typically relies on the party vote crossing ~5% (or an electorate seat) for list seats.

act.thresholdNote: Contests electorates and a long party list; party-vote share and/or an electorate seat determine list representation under MMP.

nz-first.thresholdNote: Contests electorates and a long party list; without an electorate seat, party vote near or above 5% is the usual path to seats.

te-pati-maori.thresholdNote: Official 2026 list is one candidate, reflecting an electorate-centred / optional-overhang strategy; electorate wins can bring members in even if party vote is under 5%. Campaign messaging has also discussed party votes for Labour or Greens.

opportunity.thresholdNote: Long party list; without an electorate seat, seats depend on reaching about 5% of the party vote under MMP.

alliance.thresholdNote: Contests party vote and multiple electorates; without an electorate seat, list seats still require about 5% of the nationwide party vote.

animal-justice.thresholdNote: Primarily a party-vote contest; without an electorate seat, list seats require about 5% of the nationwide party vote.

alcp.thresholdNote: Contests electorates and the party vote around cannabis reform; without an electorate seat, list seats require about 5% of the nationwide party vote.

conservative.thresholdNote: Primarily a party-vote contest; without an electorate seat, list seats require about 5% of the nationwide party vote.

free-palestine.thresholdNote: Primarily a party-vote contest; without an electorate seat, list seats require about 5% of the nationwide party vote.

nz-loyal.thresholdNote: Primarily a party-vote contest; without an electorate seat, list seats require about 5% of the nationwide party vote.

outdoors-freedom.thresholdNote: Campaign messaging emphasises winning an electorate plus party vote; without an electorate seat, list seats require about 5% of the nationwide party vote.

te-tai-tokerau.thresholdNote: Very short official list (two candidates) and regional branding point to an electorate-centred strategy; check vote.nz for electorate contests.

vision.thresholdNote: Primarily a party-vote contest; without an electorate seat, list seats require about 5% of the nationwide party vote.

womens-rights.thresholdNote: Primarily a party-vote contest; without an electorate seat, list seats require about 5% of the nationwide party vote.
